import type { ReactNode } from 'react';

/** Props for a badge. */
export interface BadgeProps {
  readonly tone: 'good' | 'bad';
  readonly children?: ReactNode;
}

/** Shows a short status. */
export function Badge({ tone, children }: BadgeProps): ReactNode {
  return <span data-tone={tone}>{children}</span>;
}

export const Dot = ({ tone }: Pick<BadgeProps, 'tone'>) => <i data-tone={tone} />;

const Inner = function Inner<T,>(props: { item: T }) {
  return <b>{String(props.item)}</b>;
};
